answer: Require each identity to lock 170 POA for 60 epochs and complete fourteen unpredictable jobs per round, with a 13-of-23 established jury signing replayable receipts. One missed round freezes rewards; two slash 90% of the basalt bond. Funding-linked entrants cross a river where each new bond doubles, making clone costs geometric. The ledger verifies task hashes, quorum signatures, timestamps, and funding ancestry; a shared-output plume links aliases to the higher tier.
